definitions.explanation: Meat or other food cut into small, thin pieces. Commonly seen on food packaging.
Describes time or activities broken up into small, discontinuous segments.

examples.english: I bought thinly sliced pork pieces.

examples.japanese: {牛|ぎゅう}{細切|こまぎ}れ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{肉|にく}じゃが→肉じゃが：17620_nikujaga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made nikujaga with beef cut into small pieces.

examples.japanese: {細切|こまぎ}れ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{薄切|うすぎ}り→薄切り：07475_usugiri⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: Small-cut meat pieces are cheaper than thinly sliced meat.

examples.japanese: {細切|こまぎ}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活用|かつよう}する→活用する：21424_katsuyousuru⟧。
examples.english: To make use of fragmented bits of time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧、{細切|こまぎ}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しか⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I have so many meetings that I can only work in small fragments.

examples.japanese: {細切|こまぎ}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}した→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I studied while taking short, intermittent breaks.

notes:
USAGE:
In the food sense, commonly seen on supermarket labels as ⟦{豚|ぶた}→豚：04710_buta⟧{細切|こまぎ}れ (pork small pieces) or {牛|ぎゅう}{細切|こまぎ}れ (beef small pieces). These are irregularly-shaped small cuts, usually cheaper than neat slices.

In the time/activity sense, often describes the frustration of not having long, uninterrupted blocks of time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {細切|こまぎ}れ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ (small-cut meat pieces)
- {細切|こまぎ}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (fragmented time)
- {細切|こまぎ}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to cut into small pieces; to fragment)
